## [Microorganism Diversity in Vineyard Soil](451_midproject_report.pdf)

My senior capstone project at Cal Poly SLO working as a client for Dr. Katie Watts under the supervision on Dr. Kelly Bodwin and Dr. Alex Dekhtyar. In this project, I worked to find drivers in microbial diversity in local vineyard soil by developing a new identification procedure that utilizes differential correlation.


## [NBA Genral Manager Hypothetical](NBA_Project.pdf)

Project where I used Scala/Spark to analyze NBA data and make hypothetical off-season roster decisions in hindsight using data available on all NBA players as if I were a general manager. I looked to make informed decisions on what players would be most beneficial to the team by analyzing team weaknesses and potential holes going into the next season.
